sent: Geonchunmun (Palace Gate)은 Seokchuk (Stone Retaining Wall / Stonework)에 Hongye / Hongyemun (arch) 하나를 내고 그 위에 단층 Mullu (Gate Tower)를 올렸습니다.
en: Geonchunmun (Palace Gate) placed a Hongye/ Hongyemun (arch) on Seokchuk (Stone Wall/Stonework) and raised a single-story Mullu (Gate Tower) on top of it.

sent: Geunjeongjeon Jojeong (Ceremonial Courtyard)에서는 새해가 되면 신하들이 임금에게 Harye (Formal Congratulations to the King)를 올렸습니다.
en: At Geunjeongjeon Jojeong (Ceremonial Courtyard), the servants gave Harye (Formal Celebrations to the King) to the king for the new year.

sent: Iljegangjeomgi (Japanese Colonial Period, 1910–1945)에 경복궁 전각 대부분이 헐릴 때도 Jagyeongjeon (Queen Dowager’s Residence)과 Hamhwadang (Bedchamber) Ilgwak (Enclosed Courtyard / Precinct)은 Joseon Chongdokbu (Japanese Government-General of Korea) 박물관 사무실로 쓰여서 남았습니다.
en: Jagyeongjeon (Queen Dowager's Residence) and Hamhwadang (Bedchamber) Ilgwak (Precinct Courtyard/Precinct) remained in use as Joseon Chongdokbu (Japanese Government-General of Korea) museum offices even when most of the entire Gyeongbokgung Palace was destroyed during Iljegangjeomgi (Japanese Colonial Period, 1910—1945).

sent: Haenggak (Covered Corridors Surrounding a Building)은 중심 건물을 둘러싸고 있는 긴 복도 같은 건물입니다.
en: Haenggak (Covered Corridors a Building) is a long corridor-like building that surrounds the central building.

sent: Paljakjibung (half-hipped roof)은 옆에서 보면 여덟 팔 자 모양이고, Ujingakjibung (Hipped Roof)은 네 면이 모두 경사진 지붕입니다.
en: Paljakjibung (half-hipped roof) has an eight-sided shape when viewed from the side, and Ujingakjibung (hipped roof) is a roof with a slope on all four sides.
